name: google-ads-client-report
description: Use when someone asks for a monthly Google Ads report for a client, wants the client deck built, needs last month's Google Ads performance written up, asks for an end-of-month PPC report, asks "what do I tell the client", or asks how to present a target they missed — even when they never say the word "report". Also use when the Google Ads section of a client review or QBR is what's wanted. For agencies and in-house teams reporting upward. Google Ads only.
